rewards.title: A little luxury. Every time.
rewards.intro: One free SOFIE membership. Earn with every eligible purchase, enjoy a birthday gift, and use your points online or in our branches.
rewards.member_store: Show this card and confirm your registered email at the till. Your balance is shared online and in store.
rewards.redeem_note: Online redemption turns points into a single-use code for your account. To use points at a branch, keep them in your balance and ask the cashier to redeem them.
rewards.store_steps: 1. Show your member number or registered email. 2. Choose a reward with the cashier. 3. The cashier applies it to your receipt and your points balance updates. Online codes are for website checkout; branch rewards are applied by staff.
rewards.birthday_intro: Add your month and day to receive a gift every year: EGP 50 for Insider, EGP 300 for VIP, or EGP 750 for Icon.
rewards.birthday_consent: I want SOFIE to save my birthday month and day and email my annual birthday gift. This does not subscribe me to other marketing emails.
rewards.birthday_terms: No birth year needed. One birthday gift per year, available for 45 days from your birthday. Choose online or in store. Credit is for merchandise, has no cash value, and cannot be combined with another discount. February 29 birthdays are observed on February 28 in other years.
rewards.correct_birthday: Contact us to correct a saved date.
rewards.join_text: Create or sign in to your SOFIE account. Membership is free, with one balance for shopping online and in store.
rewards.earn_text: Earn 1 point for every EGP 10 of eligible merchandise after discounts. VIP earns 1.25× and Icon earns 1.5×. Points are added after payment; cash on delivery earns when marked paid.
rewards.unlock_text: 100 points = EGP 50 off. 500 = EGP 250. 1,000 = EGP 550. 2,000 = EGP 1,200. Redeem online or ask your branch cashier.
rewards.celebrate_text: Your annual credit is ready from your birthday. Enrolled VIP and Icon members earn double their usual points throughout their birthday month.
rewards.both_channels: Earn and redeem online and in store
rewards.terms: Points are based on eligible merchandise after discounts, excluding shipping, taxes and gift cards. Product points are estimates; the final paid order determines the award. Returns and cancellations reverse earned points. Tiers qualify on rolling 12-month spend and earned status is held for at least 12 months. Rewards are personal, non-transferable, cannot be exchanged for cash, and cannot be combined with another discount. Online codes are single use, restricted to your account and do not return unused value. Choose a reward that fits your purchase.
rewards.extras: Earn 100 points for account creation, 250 for your first beauty quiz, and 100 per verified review (up to four per month). Existing balances and redemption rates are preserved.
rewards.estimate_note: Estimated for this option and quantity. Sign in to earn at your tier. Final points follow the paid total after discounts; shipping and taxes do not earn points.
rewards.currency_note: SOFIE points are calculated from your final EGP purchase.

hair.intro: Discover your hair profile, understand what it needs, and build a simple routine from the haircare available at SOFIE.

hair.question: Question
hair.q_texture: How does your hair look when it dries naturally?
hair.help_texture: Think of your hair without heat styling. Your pattern and the thickness of each strand are different things.
hair.help_strand: Feel a single strand between your fingers. This is about each strand, rather than how much hair you have.
hair.q_scalp: How does your scalp usually feel?
hair.help_scalp: Your roots can be oily while your lengths are dry. We treat those needs separately.
hair.scalp_seek_help: Pain, sores or sudden / patchy hair loss
hair.q_concerns: What would you most like help with?

hair.concerns_tone: Brassiness in blonde or silver hair
hair.help_colour: Choose lightened if your hair is bleached, highlighted, blonde or silver and you want toning care.
hair.q_heat: How often do you use heat to style?
hair.help_heat: Think of blow dryers, straighteners and curling tools.
hair.help_budget: Each selected size stays within this limit. Your full routine total is shown separately.

hair.profile_note: Your profile reflects the answers you shared. Edit it whenever your hair or routine changes.
hair.tone_note: Toning products are shown only when you choose lightened, blonde or silver hair. Edit your colour answer if that applies.
hair.sensitive_note: For sensitive scalps, cleansing suggestions need an explicit fragrance-free listing. Check the full ingredients for your personal allergens. If unsure, ask a dermatologist.
hair.k18_note: K18 treatment wash: shampoo, skip conditioner, towel-dry, apply the mask and wait 4 minutes before styling. We have left conditioner out of this treatment routine.

hair.matching_note: We compare your answers with the product details in our haircare collection. Every suggestion shows its reason. Availability and prices are checked again when you add to bag. Results are guidance, and individual experiences vary.
hair.reason_dryness: The product details highlight moisture care.
hair.reason_frizz: The product details highlight smoothing or frizz care.
hair.reason_damage: The product details highlight damage or breakage care.
hair.reason_curls: The product details mention curls or coils.
hair.reason_volume: The product details highlight volume or fuller-looking hair.
hair.reason_buildup: A clarifying option for the buildup you selected.
hair.reason_shine: The product details highlight shine or gloss.
hair.reason_tone: Toning care for your blonde, silver or lightened hair.
hair.reason_fine: The product details mention a lightweight feel or fine hair.
hair.reason_coarse: A richer option for substantial strands.
hair.reason_sensitive: The product listing describes a fragrance-free formula.
hair.reason_heat: The product details specify heat protection.
hair.reason_colour: The product details describe colour-safe or colour-protecting care.
hair.reason_cleanse: A cleansing step from our haircare collection.
hair.reason_condition: A conditioning step for the lengths of your hair.
hair.reason_repair: A targeted treatment step for your damage concern.
hair.reason_style: A finishing option from our haircare collection.
hair.use_cleanse: Use on your scalp as directed, then rinse. Follow the product’s own frequency and instructions.
hair.use_condition: Apply to your lengths as directed. Check whether your chosen product replaces conditioner and how long to leave it in.
hair.use_repair: Follow this treatment’s own directions and frequency.
hair.use_style: Follow the product directions for damp or dry hair. Heat protection applies only when the product explicitly states it.
hair.use_k18: After shampoo, skip conditioner and towel-dry. Apply as directed, wait 4 minutes, leave in, then style.
hair.use_no3: A pre-shampoo treatment: follow the timing on your bottle, rinse, then shampoo and condition. This is not a leave-in conditioner.
hair.support_title: Your scalp deserves a closer look.
hair.support_note: Pain, sores, sudden shedding or patchy loss can have different causes. A cosmetic quiz cannot identify them. Please speak with a dermatologist before choosing a scalp treatment.
